explanation.headline: FDA's shortage list shows Curium US LLC and Sun Pharmaceutical Industries, Inc. on allocation since 2023-12-27; a Class II recall for Curium began 2024-11-26, 335 days after the posting

sentences.text: FDA's shortage list shows Curium US LLC and Sun Pharmaceutical Industries, Inc. with Current status and initial posting date 2023-12-27.
Curium US LLC is listed as On allocation and Sun Pharmaceutical Industries, Inc. shows Estimated Recovery: TBD.
A Class II recall by Curium US, LLC started 2024-11-26 for lack of assurance of sterility and improper crimps on vials, 335 days after the shortage posting.
As of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been on FDA's list for 34 months.
Corvale East holds 22 vials of the 10 mL presentation at 2.8 vials per day, providing 7.8 days on hand.
The top-ranked option is to buy from Jubilant DraxImage Inc., dba Jubilant Radiopharma, which is not on FDA's shortage list today.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
